deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next prioritize housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference, re-captured whenever a feature change legitimately alters the doc surfaces.
description: Line counts of prioritize doc surfaces, re-captured after issue #214 (same-feature serialization) legitimately added behaviour to docs/spec.md and docs/contract.md. The prior baseline (spec.md=95, contract.md=30, captured at f705266) recorded an honest doc-reduction NO-OP; this revision raises it to the post-#214 surface (spec.md=144, contract.md=31) because the serialization fix is a genuine feature addition, not silent doc bloat. The housekeep e2e gates continue to assert behavior preserved, no load-bearing token dropped, and that the docs do not drift PAST this new baseline.
